decisions.route: One-piece PE family with baseline and high-molecular-weight blend controls
decisions.action: Keep as first material comparison; do not assume simultaneous low friction and high wear resistance.
decisions.change_reason: Original blend research shows tradeoff and demanding processing.

decisions.action: Add as independent material architecture combined with protected contact geometry.
decisions.change_reason: Primary unlubricated steel tests support wear improvement but not ski performance; cost and mass penalty calculated.

decisions.route: Hard core with soft continuous skin
decisions.action: Demote blanket coating; evaluate only after uncoated controls.
decisions.change_reason: 2um skin on60um strand is13.78% added volume or19.29% lower fixed-outer EI at modulus ratio0.2.

decisions.route: Broader outer curvature and interior holding contacts
decisions.action: Co-optimize pressure and interfacial shear; check random orientation and finite thickness.
decisions.change_reason: Conditional50→150um radius halves maximum Hertz pressure but doubles contact area.

decisions.action: Apply both same-condition modulus and allowable-stress gates.
decisions.change_reason: POM needsE ratio>2.157 to beat referencePE beam mass; E ratio3 also needs2.28x allowable stress.
